protocol.calibration: per set and vehicle: benign train_01 captures (attack-free, accessory); the known vehicle uses its own set's train captures, an unknown vehicle the captures of the sets where it is known, minus any content in the set's test or validation captures; ROAD: ambient captures with role train
protocol.road_test: attack runs ending in _2 (also _2_masquerade); every 4th ambient capture by CRC32
protocol.validation: highest-numbered capture per attack type in train_01
